verdict.rationale: Cooley's own IP litigation page names specific venues and volumes: 575+ patent cases, 80+ Federal Circuit appeals, 13 patent trials, 475+ PTAB proceedings and 30+ Section 337 ITC investigations. Its labor and employment page separately describes successfully representing clients in trade secret litigation. Missing for 10: concrete case outcomes or win rates, evidence of trademark litigation (the trademark page covers brand protection, not disputes), and independent corroboration.
